figures.description: 晴朗的下午，生物老師帶著全班在校園的大樹下上植物觀察課。左邊一個女生蹲在花圃旁，拿著放大鏡看一朵小黃花；中間一個男生把撿到的樹葉舉高對著光，旁邊的男生在筆記本上畫樹葉的形狀；右邊一個女生用平板電腦替樹葉拍照；老師站在樹旁，指著樹幹上的名牌向學生說明。

questions.stem: 提示：生物課有時會走出教室，讓學生到校園裡觀察植物。請仔細看下面的圖片，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段描述圖中的學生們在植物觀察課上做哪些事；第二段寫出你自己上過的一次戶外課或觀察活動，並說明你喜歡或不喜歡在教室外上課的原因。

1.explanation_zh: 這一題有三個要求：第一段描述圖中學生在觀察課上的動作（用放大鏡看花、舉起葉子、畫筆記、拍照、老師說明）；第二段寫一次自己上過的戶外課或觀察活動，再說明喜歡或不喜歡在教室外上課的原因。喜歡或不喜歡都可以，重點是理由要和自己的經驗連在一起。
evidence: 第一段描述圖中的學生們在植物觀察課上做哪些事
說明你喜歡或不喜歡在教室外上課的原因
1.strategy_zh: 描述圖片時用 through a magnifying glass、with a tablet 這類「用什麼工具」的片語，句子會更具體；經驗段寫清楚地點、觀察到什麼、學到什麼。
hints: 第一段：On the left, a girl is looking at … through …
第二段：Last …, my class had an outdoor lesson in … 接觀察到的一件事
最後用 I like / I do not like having classes outside because … 回應題目

moves.zh: 描述圖中的學生們在植物觀察課上做哪些事
寫出你自己上過的一次戶外課或觀察活動
說明你喜歡或不喜歡在教室外上課的原因

content.focus_zh: 第一段寫出圖中至少三種觀察動作；第二段要有一次具體的戶外或觀察經驗（地點、看到什麼），並說明喜歡或不喜歡的理由。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段依位置描述，第二段依「經驗經過、學到什麼、喜歡與否的理由」排列；可以承認戶外課的缺點，再回到自己的立場。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 圖片用現在進行式、經驗用過去式；介系詞片語（through a magnifying glass、with a tablet）要放對位置。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 放大鏡、樹葉、筆記本、戶外課等字（magnifying glass、leaf／leaves、notebook、outdoor）要拼對；leaf 的複數是 leaves。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

sentence_starters: On the left, a girl is looking at ...
Last ..., my class had an outdoor lesson ...
I like having classes outside because ...

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The picture shows a biology class under a big tree on campus. Instead of sitting in the classroom, the students are learning about plants outside. On the left, a girl is looking at a small yellow flower through a magnifying glass. In the middle, one boy is holding up a leaf, and another boy is drawing its shape in his notebook. Meanwhile, a girl on the right is taking a photo of a leaf with a tablet. Behind them, the teacher is pointing at the name sign on the tree and explaining something to the class.
Last spring, my class also had an outdoor lesson in the school garden. Our job was to watch how bees visit flowers. At first, I was afraid of the bees, but our teacher told us to stay calm and move slowly. Then I saw a bee with yellow powder on its legs flying from one flower to another. I like having classes outside because I can see real things, not just pictures in a book. For example, after watching that bee, I finally understood how flowers make seeds. Also, the fresh air keeps me awake. However, outdoor classes can be hard on rainy or very hot days. All in all, I hope we can have more lessons like this because they make learning fun.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 圖中的觀察動作與自己的戶外經驗都寫到，理由也有例子（內容 4）；段落分工清楚，轉承語正確但變化不多（組織 4）；句子正確，以簡單句為主（文法句構 4）；用字正確但偏基礎（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
On a sunny afternoon, the biology class in the picture has traded its classroom for the shade of a huge tree. Crouching beside a flower bed, a girl is examining a tiny yellow blossom through a magnifying glass, as if she were a detective searching for clues. A few steps away, one boy is holding a fallen leaf up to the light, while his partner is carefully sketching its outline in a notebook. On the right, another girl is photographing leaves with a tablet, building a digital archive that the class can compare later. Behind them all, the teacher is pointing to the name tag on the trunk, connecting what the students see with what they have read in their textbooks.
This scene reminds me of a project I joined in tenth grade, when each group in my class adopted one tree on campus for a whole semester. My group chose a young maple near the gym. Every Friday, we measured its height, counted its new leaves, and took photos from the same spot. At first, the task felt tedious, and some of us wanted to give up after the third week because nothing seemed to change. However, by the end of the semester, our photos revealed a surprising story. It was worth the wait. The tree had grown eleven centimeters, and its leaves had turned from green to crimson. Seeing that change with my own eyes taught me far more than any chart in a textbook, and it completely changed my perspective on biology. Admittedly, outdoor lessons are not always pleasant, since mosquitoes and sudden showers can easily interrupt them. Nevertheless, I prefer learning outside, because it trains us to observe patiently and to trust evidence rather than guesses. Overall, this habit of looking closely has proved invaluable, not only in biology but in every subject.

paragraphs.function_zh: 描述圖片：以「把教室換成樹蔭」開場，用分詞片語與比喻寫出四種觀察方式，最後點出老師把觀察和課本連起來

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 圖片描述有動作、工具與目的，經驗段有方法、數據、讓步與見解（內容 5）；從圖片自然轉到自己的經驗，結尾提出可以延伸到各科的看法（組織 5）；分詞片語、as if、過去完成式使用正確（文法句構 5）；tedious、perspective 等字用得精確，但整體以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

errors.excerpt: building a digital archive that the class can compare later
errors.explanation_zh: compare 需要兩個以上的比較對象，「全班之後可以比較的一個數位資料庫」語意不完整；要比較的是資料庫裡的葉子或照片。
errors.suggestion: building a digital archive so that the class can compare the leaves later

top.comment_zh: 第一段五個觀察動作寫得細膩（as if she were a detective、connecting what the students see with what they have read），第二段以一學期認養校園楓樹的觀察計畫為經驗，有過程、想放棄的轉折、具體數據的結果與讓步，理由清楚，字彙與句構屬頂標程度。組織上，「our photos revealed a surprising story. It was worth the wait. The tree had grown…」中間插入 It was worth the wait，打斷了「驚人的故事」和故事內容的銜接；結尾的 this habit of looking closely 前文沒有明確建立；change／changed 相鄰重複。題目要「一次」戶外課，這篇寫一學期的計畫，仍屬可接受的觀察活動。

steady.comment_zh: 圖中四個學生的動作與老師的說明都寫到；第二段有在校園花園觀察蜜蜂的具體經驗，喜歡的理由（看到真東西、新鮮空氣）並以了解花如何結籽為例，也提到雨天、炎熱的缺點。文法正確、組織清楚；用字較基本（yellow powder 可用 pollen），句型變化有限。
